$comment: Authored guide for the Agentic AI track (s23). The loop, repeated-action detection and tool-argument validation examples are real executable Python, so scripts/guides.cjs stores genuine stdout.

guides.title: Agent Loops, Tools & Guardrails
guides.what: Agent ek loop hai: observe → plan → tool call → result → repeat, jab tak goal na pura ho ya bound hit na ho. LLM decision leta hai, host loop ko bound karta hai, aur tools side effects karte hain.
guides.why: Unbounded agents cost blow-up aur production incidents ka source hote hain (infinite tool calls, duplicate orders, galat arguments). Bounds + validation + idempotency ke bina agent demo theek chalta hai, production me nahi.
guides.whereUsed: Support automation, data pipelines jo multi-step hain, research/summarisation workflows, aur n8n/LangChain style orchestrations.
guides.howItWorks: Har step par planner ek action chunta hai (tool + arguments), host action ko validate karta hai, tool execute hota hai aur uska result context me wapas jaata hai. Loop ke teen guards: max_steps, repeated-action detection, aur per-tool attempt cap. Side-effecting tools ke liye idempotency key chahiye — retry ko naya event samajhna duplicate side effect deta hai.

explain: Bounded loop: har action ek step hai, aur 'stop' action par clean exit hota hai.
Khaali plan par safe no-op (stop) hota hai — agent ko crash nahi hone dena chahiye.
Plan me stop na ho to max_steps guard loop ko rokta hai — yahi cost runaway se bachata hai.
Repeated-action detection wahi action dobara dekh kar loop halt kar deta hai — planner ke loop me phasne ka fix.
max_steps host ka guard hai aur repeated-action check planner ke bug ka guard — dono chahiye.
Dusre case me teen alag actions hain aur 'stop' par clean exit hota hai, isliye halting trigger nahi hoti.
Tool arguments ko execute karne se PEHLE schema se validate kiya jata hai — LLM output 99% sahi hota hai, bacha 1% production me har din aata hai.
bool ko explicitly reject kiya gaya kyunki Python me True int ka subclass hai (isinstance(True, int) True hota hai).
Invalid payload par structured error lauta rahe hain, crash nahi — agent isi error ko dekh kar repair kar sakta hai.

howToCode.detail: max_steps, per-tool attempt cap aur deadline set karo; koi bhi loop bina bound ke production me nahi jaana chahiye.

howToCode.step: Tool call se pehle validate karo
howToCode.detail: Arguments ko schema se check karo (types + ranges), aur invalid par agent ko structured error do — crash nahi.
howToCode.code:
problems = validate(payload)
if problems: return {"ok": False, "errors": problems}

howToCode.detail: Side-effecting tool ke saath idempotency key bhejo aur webhook handlers me event_id ka processed-log rakho — retry duplicate order nahi banaye.
Step number, action, arguments, result aur latency log karo — cost attribution aur debugging dono isi se hota hai.

commonMistakes: Bina max_steps/attempt cap ke loop chalana — cost runaway.
Repeated action ke liye koi check na hona (planner loop me phans jata hai).
Tool arguments bina validate execute karna (wrong type se 500 error).
Retry ko naya event samajhna — duplicate payments/orders.
Human approval gate har tool me duplicate karna (ek policy layer me hona chahiye).
bestPractices: Policy (approval/whitelist) loop level par rakho, mechanism tool me.
Har tool call ka structured log rakho (step, action, args, result, latency, cost).
Structured output (JSON schema) maango aur validate karo — free-text parse karna fragile hai.
Failure par degraded behaviour define karo (retry → fallback → clear message).
Golden trace set rakho aur regression test ki tarah chalाओ.
guides.realWorld: Order automation jahan agent tool call karta hai (aur webhook retry par duplicate order nahi banna chahiye), aur multi-step research agent jahan 8 steps ke baad summary chahiye — dono bounded + logged design maangte hain. Interview me 'maine multi-agent ko single agent + deterministic state machine me badla, 40% cost kam hui' bolna excellent signal hai.

practice.text: Ek bounded agent loop likho jo max_steps ke baad 'halt' log kare.
Repeated-action detection add karo aur do trace print karo (loop halt vs clean exit).
Ek tool registry likho jisme schema validation, idempotency key aur audit log ho.

interview.q: Agent ko cost runaway se kaise bachaaoge?
interview.a: max_steps + per-tool attempt cap + deadline, aur har tool call ka cost log. Retry policy sirf transient errors par — aur prompt/context size cap lagao.

interview.q: Webhook dobara aane par duplicate order kaise rokoge?
interview.a: event_id par processed-log (unique constraint) rakho; duplicate par short-circuit karke wahi response do. Side-effecting calls me idempotency key bhejo.
Loop/policy level par (action whitelist + approval state + audit log), tool ke andar nahi — warna naya tool add karte waqt enforcement toot jata hai.

guides.miniChallenge: Ek agent loop likho jisme max_steps, repeated-action halt, tool schema validation aur ek audit log (list of dicts) — sab ek jagah ho.
guides.debugTask: Agent ne same search tool 6 baar call kiya aur bill 5x ho gaya. Reproduce karo aur guards likho jo ye rok dete.
revision: Idempotency key side effects ke liye
Policy loop me, mechanism tool me
guides.interviewTip: Agent sawal par ye bolo: 'bounded aur logged loop hi tunable hota hai — bina cost/latency log ke agent quality vs cost ka decision hi nahi liya ja sakta'.
